headline: Aspinall averages 111.68 in Grand Slam win over Kuivenhoven
standfirst: Nathan Aspinall won five legs in a row to beat Maik Kuivenhoven 5-1 in the opening Group P match at Wolverhampton.
body: Nathan Aspinall made a commanding start to the Grand Slam of Darts, beating Maik Kuivenhoven 5-1 in Group P and finishing with an average of 111.68.
Aspinall won the last five legs of the match in succession. He came close to a nine-darter in one leg before finishing it in 13 darts, and narrowly missed the tournament's record average.

He reached Wolverhampton in a good frame of mind, telling the outlet he is in "a very, very good headspace" at the moment. That sits alongside a decision away from the oche: he chose to skip the last two Pro Tour events and so missed out on the Players Championship Finals.

Aspinall explained that the weekend coincided with his wife's birthday and that he wanted to spend it away together rather than practising. He also said he wanted to avoid negativity before the big televised events.
With only one player from each three-man group advancing, the opening win puts him in a strong position. He plays Karel Sedláček in his final group match.
